It is shown whole on fateless.ai, in the browse view here, and on the plugin's Discord thread; Discord's forum card crops it square, so keep the subject centered. plugins.publish.field.slug_invalid: This title can't be turned into a folder name the hub accepts. Use letters and numbers.

plugins.publish.field.version_listing_hi: The version of the hosted mod this listing describes. It shows on the browse card, carries the changelog, and bumps the "Recently Updated" filter.
plugins.publish.field.version_unchanged_: Same version as the published release ({{version}}). Bump it so the update is recognisable and picks up the Recently Updated filter.
plugins.publish.guidelines.actions_body: Plugins containing actions invoke Papyrus functions, so they always get human review. Expect up to a week before approval.
plugins.publish.guidelines.content_body: Pick only prompts, actions, and triggers that are yours to share. Knowledge packs are auto-exported from your current game at publish time.
plugins.publish.guidelines.footer: By publishing, you agree to the hub's content policy. Submissions can be taken down if they violate it.
plugins.publish.guidelines.image_body: Use a screenshot or artwork that depicts the plugin. No outright sexual content even on adult plugins, no real people, no ads, links, or QR codes.
plugins.publish.guidelines.markdown_body: Headings, bold/italic, lists, inline/fenced code, blockquotes, and tables render. Links, images, raw HTML, and scripts are stripped.
plugins.publish.guidelines.metadata_body: Title and tagline tell other users what your plugin does. Placeholder or test strings are auto-rejected by the review agent.
plugins.publish.guidelines.nsfw_body: Toggle the adult-content switch if your plugin contains explicit sexual material. Violence, gore, and dark themes do not require the flag.
plugins.publish.guidelines.review_body: Prompts, triggers, and knowledge packs are reviewed by an automated agent. Approved submissions may take up to 5 minutes to appear.
plugins.publish.guidelines.title: Submission Guidelines
plugins.publish.guidelines.type_body: Bundles ship prompt / action / trigger / knowledge files directly through the hub. Listings are pointers to a mod hosted somewhere else (e.g. Nexus or GitHub) and always require manual human review.
plugins.publish.invocation.attestation_l: I tested these actions in-game and observed no save corruption, crashes, or quest breakage.
plugins.publish.invocation.hint: Actions are reviewed by a human before merge. Help the reviewer understand what the action does and why it's safe.
plugins.publish.invocation.per_action_hi: For each included action, list the Skyrim mod(s) whose Papyrus functions it calls. Each action needs at least one.

plugins.publish.invocation.vanilla_hint: This action only calls base-game / Creation Kit Papyrus functions. No community mod required.
